name: Frisians (Inter-Frisian flag)
description: A yellow field with a white Nordic cross fimbriated in dark blue, and four red pompeblêden (stylised water-lily leaves), one in each quarter.
history: The unofficial Inter-Frisian flag was introduced in 2006 by the Groep fan Auwerk to represent all three Frisian regions — West Frisia in the Netherlands and East and North Frisia in Germany. The Nordic cross alludes to the Frisians' North Sea neighbours; the four leaves stand for the Frisian lands.
